Suzlon secures 400 MW wind energy order from Tata Power for Andhra Pradesh

Suzlon has announced securing a new order for a 400 MW wind energy project. The order comes from Tata Power Renewable Energy and is intended for a project in Andhra Pradesh. This development marks a significant capacity addition in the renewable energy sector.
